title: Inside the Standard Library: contains
hints: One version takes a predicate; the other compares with `==`, which needs a constraint.
Put the equality version in `extension Sequence where Element: Equatable` and reuse the predicate version.
`for element in self where try predicate(element) { return true }`.
jsBridge: Two overloads: `contains(where:)` for any element, and `contains(_:)` only `where Element: Equatable`. This is **conditional API availability**, which JS/TS can only approximate with overloads on generic constraints.
